name: application-11
title: Support inbox
description: An Oatfield support inbox: tickets with status, priority and unread marks beside the conversation and a copilot that reads the ticket, fills the customer card and searches the help center, then its draft arrives in the reply box with its sources to insert, edit or discard, a refund waits for Allow or Deny and the answered ticket travels to Solved. Plug your help desk into onSend, onApprove and onDeny.
